data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter calendar widget inspired by Google Calendar.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ready‑to‑use calendar view with support for displaying events, custom cell styling, and page navigation. Callbacks let you react to date taps and page changes.
use_when: You need a quick, cross‑platform calendar UI in a Flutter app
You want to display a list of events on specific dates with simple customization
avoid_when: You require complex recurrence rules or built‑in event editing
You prefer a solution without Riverpod as a dependency
strengths: Easy to drop‑in and works on all major Flutter platforms
Rich callbacks for customizing labels, cell taps, and page changes
Uses Riverpod for state handling, fitting well with modern Flutter architectures
weaknesses: Limited to basic event display; no advanced scheduling features
Adds a Riverpod dependency even if you don't use it elsewhere
